riddles.q: I have hands but I cannot clap. I have a face but I cannot smile. What am I?
hints: You can find me on a wall or on a wrist.
I tick all day and tell you when to leave for school.
It has 5 letters and it starts with C.
riddles.why: A clock has hands and a face, and it tells you the time.

riddles.q: What has keys but cannot open a single door?
hints: You can make music with me.
Black and white keys, and you press them with your fingers.
It has 5 letters and it starts with P.
riddles.why: A piano has keys that make notes, not keys that open locks.

riddles.q: What has a head and a tail but no body?
hints: You might find me in your pocket or in a fountain.
Flip me to decide who goes first.
It has 4 letters and it starts with C.
riddles.why: A coin has a head side and a tail side, but no body.

riddles.q: I am tall when I am young and short when I am old. What am I?
hints: I glow, and I am often found on a birthday cake.
Light my wick and I slowly melt away.
It has 6 letters and it starts with C.
riddles.why: A candle burns down and gets shorter the longer it burns.

riddles.q: What has an eye but cannot see?
hints: Think of a sewing box.
Thread goes through my eye.
It has 6 letters and it starts with N.
riddles.why: A needle has a small hole called an eye for the thread.

riddles.q: What has teeth but never bites, and helps you tidy your hair?
hints: You use me in front of a mirror.
I have a handle and a row of thin teeth.
It has 4 letters and it starts with C.
riddles.why: A comb has teeth, but they only smooth your hair.

riddles.q: What gets wetter the more it dries?
hints: You use me after a bath or a swim.
I hang in the bathroom.
It has 5 letters and it starts with T.
riddles.why: A towel soaks up water, so it gets wetter as you get dry.

riddles.q: I speak without a mouth and hear without ears. Shout in a canyon and I answer. What am I?
hints: I live in caves and canyons.
I repeat the last words you say.
It has 4 letters and it starts with E.
riddles.why: An echo is sound bouncing back, so it seems to repeat you.

riddles.q: What has a neck but no head?
hints: You can pour a drink from me.
I have a cap on top and a body made of glass or plastic.
It has 6 letters and it starts with B.
riddles.why: A bottle has a neck at the top, but no head.

riddles.q: What has a thumb and four fingers but is not alive?
hints: You wear me when it is cold.
I keep your hands warm in the snow.
It has 5 letters and it starts with G.
riddles.why: A glove has a thumb and four finger sleeves, but it is not alive.

riddles.q: What runs but never walks, has a bed but never sleeps, and has a mouth but never talks?
hints: I flow through the countryside.
I begin in the hills and finish at the sea.
It has 5 letters and it starts with R.
riddles.why: A river runs, has a riverbed, and has a mouth where it meets the sea.

riddles.q: I have four legs and a flat top, but I never walk. You eat dinner at me. What am I?
hints: You find me in the kitchen.
Chairs gather around me at mealtimes.
It has 5 letters and it starts with T.
riddles.why: A table has four legs and a flat top for meals.

riddles.q: What has pages and words but never speaks?
hints: You can read me at bedtime.
I have a cover and a spine.
It has 4 letters and it starts with B.
riddles.why: A book is full of words, but it never says them out loud.

riddles.q: What can you catch but never throw?
hints: Sneezes and sniffles spread me.
You get me in the winter and stay home in bed.
It has 4 letters and it starts with C.
riddles.why: You can catch a cold, but you cannot throw one.

riddles.q: What falls from the clouds but never gets hurt?
hints: I make puddles.
You need an umbrella when I come.
It has 4 letters and it starts with R.
riddles.why: Rain falls from the sky and is never hurt.

riddles.q: What starts with T, ends with T, and is full of T?
hints: You pour from me at tea time.
I have a spout, a lid and a handle.
It has 6 letters and it starts with T.
riddles.why: A teapot starts and ends with T, and it is full of tea.

riddles.q: What goes over hills and through towns but never moves?
hints: Cars drive on me.
I have a white line down the middle.
It has 4 letters and it starts with R.
riddles.why: A road goes up hills and through towns, but it stays in place.

riddles.q: What has a ring but no finger?
hints: I sit in your pocket or on a desk.
Answer me when I buzz and sing.
It has 9 letters and it starts with T.
riddles.why: A telephone has a ring, but no finger to wear it on.

riddles.q: I can fill a room but take up no space. Flip a switch and I am here. What am I?
hints: I help you read at night.
A lamp makes me, and a sunrise does too.
It has 5 letters and it starts with L.
riddles.why: Light fills a room, but it takes up no space.

riddles.q: What is full of holes but still holds water?
hints: You use me in the bath or to wash dishes.
I am soft and squishy.
It has 6 letters and it starts with S.
riddles.why: A sponge is full of holes, yet it soaks up water.

riddles.q: I follow you all day, copy every move, and vanish when the lights go out. What am I?
hints: You make me when you block the sun.
I am long in the evening and short at noon.
It has 6 letters and it starts with S.
riddles.why: A shadow follows you, copies you, and disappears in the dark.

riddles.q: What must be broken before you can use it?
hints: You eat me at breakfast.
I have a shell and a yolk.
It has 3 letters and it starts with E.
riddles.why: You must break an egg before you can cook it.

riddles.q: I am big and gray with a long trunk, big ears and tusks. What am I?
hints: I am the largest animal on land.
I never forget, so people say.
It has 8 letters and it starts with E.
riddles.why: An elephant has a trunk, big ears and tusks.

riddles.q: I look like a horse wearing black and white pajamas. I live on the African plains. What am I?
hints: I am found in a safari.
My coat is striped.
It has 5 letters and it starts with Z.
riddles.why: A zebra is a horse-like animal with black and white stripes.

riddles.q: I have the longest neck of any animal. I eat leaves from the tops of trees. What am I?
hints: I am very tall and spotted.
I live in Africa.
It has 7 letters and it starts with G.
riddles.why: A giraffe has a very long neck for reaching tall treetops.

riddles.q: I am a bird that cannot fly, but I swim like a fish and wear a tuxedo. What am I?
hints: I like icy places.
I waddle and slide on my belly in the snow.
It has 7 letters and it starts with P.
riddles.why: A penguin cannot fly, but it swims well and looks like it wears a tuxedo.

riddles.q: I carry my baby in a pouch and hop across Australia. What am I?
hints: I have a strong tail and big back legs.
Joey is the name of my baby.
It has 8 letters and it starts with K.
riddles.why: A kangaroo carries its baby in a pouch and hops.

riddles.q: I make honey and buzz from flower to flower. What am I?
hints: I live in a hive.
I can sting, so watch out.
It has 3 letters and it starts with B.
riddles.why: A bee makes honey and buzzes between flowers.

riddles.q: I have eight legs and I spin a web. What am I?
hints: I catch flies in my trap.
Itsy bitsy, in the nursery rhyme.
It has 6 letters and it starts with S.
riddles.why: A spider has eight legs and spins a web.

riddles.q: I stay up all night and say "who". I can turn my head almost all the way around. What am I?
hints: I am a bird of the night.
I have big round eyes and I hoot.
It has 3 letters and it starts with O.
riddles.why: An owl is awake at night, hoots and turns its head far around.

riddles.q: I carry my house on my back and leave a slimy trail. What am I?
hints: I am small and very slow.
I live in the garden and have a spiral shell.
It has 5 letters and it starts with S.
riddles.why: A snail carries its shell like a house and leaves a slimy trail.

riddles.q: I start as a tadpole with a tail. I grow long legs and say ribbit. What am I?
hints: I live near ponds.
I hop and catch bugs with my tongue.
It has 4 letters and it starts with F.
riddles.why: A frog begins life as a tadpole and later hops and croaks.

riddles.q: I begin as a hungry caterpillar, sleep in a cocoon and wake up with colorful wings. What am I?
hints: I flutter from flower to flower.
My wings are very pretty.
It has 9 letters and it starts with B.
riddles.why: A caterpillar turns into a butterfly after it rests in a chrysalis.

riddles.q: I live in water, breathe through gills and am covered in scales. What am I?
hints: I swim in schools.
I swim in a pond or in a bowl.
It has 4 letters and it starts with F.
riddles.why: A fish lives in water, breathes with gills and has scales.

riddles.q: I have humps on my back and can cross a desert without a drink for days. What am I?
hints: I am found in the desert.
People ride on my back in sandy lands.
It has 5 letters and it starts with C.
riddles.why: A camel stores fat in its humps and can go a long time without water.

riddles.q: I am slow, I wear a shell and I can pull my head inside. What am I?
hints: In a famous race, I beat a speedy hare by being steady.
I live a very long time.
It has 6 letters and it starts with T.
riddles.why: A turtle is slow, has a shell and hides its head inside it.

riddles.q: I am a mammal that flies at night, hangs upside down and finds my way by sound. What am I?
hints: I sleep in caves in the day.
People think of me at Halloween.
It has 3 letters and it starts with B.
riddles.why: A bat flies at night, sleeps upside down and uses echoes to find its way.

riddles.q: I say moo and I give milk. What am I?
hints: I live on a farm.
I eat grass and chew it twice.
It has 3 letters and it starts with C.
riddles.why: A cow says moo and gives milk.

riddles.q: I say quack, I waddle, and water rolls off my back. What am I?
hints: I swim in the pond.
I have webbed feet and a flat bill.
It has 4 letters and it starts with D.
riddles.why: A duck quacks, waddles and has waterproof feathers.

riddles.q: I lay eggs and I say cluck. What am I?
hints: I live on a farm.
I wake the farm with a rooster friend.
It has 7 letters and it starts with C.
riddles.why: A chicken lays eggs and clucks.

riddles.q: I roll in the mud and say oink. What am I?
hints: I live on a farm and love slop.
I have a curly tail and a snout.
It has 3 letters and it starts with P.
riddles.why: A pig oinks and loves to roll in mud.

riddles.q: My wool is made into sweaters and I say baa. What am I?
hints: I eat grass on the hills.
A farmer shears my coat in spring.
It has 5 letters and it starts with S.
riddles.why: A sheep says baa and gives wool.

riddles.q: I sleep through the winter and I love honey. I am big and furry. What am I?
hints: I live in the woods and fish in streams.
I might be brown, black or white.
It has 4 letters and it starts with B.
riddles.why: A bear hibernates in winter and loves honey.

riddles.q: I swing from tree to tree and love to eat bananas. What am I?
hints: I live in the jungle.
I have a long tail and I am playful.
It has 6 letters and it starts with M.
riddles.why: A monkey swings through trees and loves bananas.

riddles.q: I keep you dry in the rain, and I open and close. What am I?
hints: You carry me on a wet day.
I have a handle and a round canopy.
It has 8 letters and it starts with U.
riddles.why: An umbrella keeps rain off you when you open it.

riddles.q: I scoop your soup and your cereal. What am I?
hints: You find me in the kitchen drawer.
I have a bowl and a handle.
It has 5 letters and it starts with S.
riddles.why: A spoon is used to scoop soup and cereal.

riddles.q: I have teeth and I open locks. I live on a ring with my friends. What am I?
hints: You need me to get into the house.
Turn me in the lock.
It has 3 letters and it starts with K.
riddles.why: A key has teeth that match a lock and opens it.

riddles.q: I show your face but I never tell a lie. I am flat and made of glass. What am I?
hints: I hang on a wall or in the bathroom.
You look at me to brush your hair.
It has 6 letters and it starts with M.
riddles.why: A mirror shows your face just as it is.

riddles.q: I have bristles and I clean your teeth every morning. What am I?
hints: I live in the bathroom next to the toothpaste.
You use me twice a day.
It has 10 letters and it starts with T.
riddles.why: A toothbrush cleans teeth with its bristles.

riddles.q: You rest your head on me at night. I am soft and stuffed with feathers or foam. What am I?
hints: I live on the bed.
You hug me when you sleep.
It has 6 letters and it starts with P.
riddles.why: A pillow is a soft cushion for your head.

riddles.q: I have a mattress and sheets, and you sleep on me. What am I?
hints: You find me in the room where you sleep.
You get tucked in on me.
It has 3 letters and it starts with B.
riddles.why: A bed is where you lie down and sleep.

riddles.q: I come in pairs, but one of me always goes missing in the wash. What am I?
hints: I go on your feet inside your shoes.
I can be striped or spotted.
It has 4 letters and it starts with S.
riddles.why: A sock comes in a pair, and one often goes missing.

riddles.q: I have a tongue and laces but I cannot talk or tie myself. What am I?
hints: I protect your foot.
I go on your foot before you walk out.
It has 4 letters and it starts with S.
riddles.why: A shoe has a tongue and laces, but it cannot talk.

riddles.q: I am small and round with holes, and I hold your shirt closed. What am I?
hints: I am sewn on with thread.
I go through a loop or hole on your coat.
It has 6 letters and it starts with B.
riddles.why: A button holds clothes closed.

riddles.q: I have rungs, and you climb me to reach high shelves. What am I?
hints: Painters and firefighters use me.
I lean against the wall.
It has 6 letters and it starts with L.
riddles.why: A ladder has rungs you climb to reach high places.

riddles.q: I sweep the floor, and witches ride me in stories. What am I?
hints: I have bristles at one end.
I clean up dust and crumbs.
It has 5 letters and it starts with B.
riddles.why: A broom sweeps the floor, and witches ride broomsticks in tales.

riddles.q: I have prongs and I help you eat spaghetti. What am I?
hints: I sit next to the knife and the spoon.
I have a handle and sharp points.
It has 4 letters and it starts with F.
riddles.why: A fork has prongs for picking up food.

riddles.q: I have two blades but I am not a knife. I snip paper and cloth. What am I?
hints: You use me for crafts.
I open and close and have two finger loops.
It has 8 letters and it starts with S.
riddles.why: Scissors have two blades that snip.

riddles.q: I whistle when I boil and I make tea. What am I?
hints: I sit on the stove.
I steam when the water gets hot.
It has 6 letters and it starts with K.
riddles.why: A kettle whistles when its water boils.

riddles.q: You see through me but I am not air. I am a pane in the wall. What am I?
hints: I let light in.
Curtains cover me.
It has 6 letters and it starts with W.
riddles.why: A window is a glass pane you see through.

riddles.q: I swing open and shut, and I have a knob. You walk through me. What am I?
hints: I am between rooms.
I keep out the cold or burglars.
It has 4 letters and it starts with D.
riddles.why: A door swings open and shut and has a knob.

riddles.q: I have steps but I never walk. You go up and down on me. What am I?
hints: I connect floors in a building.
I have a rail.
It has 6 letters and it starts with S.
riddles.why: Stairs have steps that you climb.

riddles.q: I span a river so you can cross. What am I?
hints: Cars and trains use me.
I stand on pillars over water.
It has 6 letters and it starts with B.
riddles.why: A bridge lets you cross a river.

riddles.q: I am round and I go round and round. I help a car and a bike roll. What am I?
hints: I am on a bike.
I turn on an axle.
It has 5 letters and it starts with W.
riddles.why: A wheel is round and turns to help things roll.

riddles.q: I float up in the sky when you let go of me. I pop when pricked. What am I?
hints: I am full of air or helium.
I come at birthday parties on a string.
It has 7 letters and it starts with B.
riddles.why: A balloon floats when filled with helium and pops if pricked.

riddles.q: I fly high on a string on a windy day. What am I?
hints: I have a tail and a frame.
You hold my string at the park.
It has 4 letters and it starts with K.
riddles.why: A kite flies on the wind and is held by a string.

riddles.q: I am three snowballs stacked up, with a carrot nose. What am I?
hints: I appear in winter.
I wear a scarf and hat and I melt when it is warm.
It has 7 letters and it starts with S.
riddles.why: A snowman is made from snowballs and has a carrot nose.

riddles.q: I appear after rain with seven colors but I have no end. What am I?
hints: I curve across the sky.
You need sun and rain together to see me.
It has 7 letters and it starts with R.
riddles.why: A rainbow shows seven colors when sunlight shines through rain.

riddles.q: I change shape in the night sky, from a thin curve to a big circle. What am I?
hints: I shine at night.
I orbit the Earth.
It has 4 letters and it starts with M.
riddles.why: The moon changes shape during the month as we see its lit side.

riddles.q: I am a hot ball of fire in the sky. I give you light and warmth. What am I?
hints: I rise in the morning.
You put on lotion at the beach when I am bright.
It has 3 letters and it starts with S.
riddles.why: The sun gives light and warmth to the Earth.

riddles.q: I am white and fluffy and I float in the sky. When I'm gray, rain may come. What am I?
hints: I drift above your head.
I look like cotton in the sky.
It has 5 letters and it starts with C.
riddles.why: A cloud is a fluffy mass of water drops in the sky.

riddles.q: I am water that turned hard and cold. I melt in your drink. What am I?
hints: I clink in a glass.
I come from the freezer.
It has 3 letters and it starts with I.
riddles.why: Ice is frozen water and it melts in a drink.

riddles.q: I have lead but I am not made of metal. You sharpen me to write. What am I?
hints: I am yellow in many classrooms.
I have an eraser on the end.
It has 6 letters and it starts with P.
riddles.why: A pencil's "lead" is graphite, not metal, and it needs sharpening.

riddles.q: I have days, weeks and months, and I hang on the wall. What am I?
hints: You flip my pages to see the date.
Mark your birthday on me.
It has 8 letters and it starts with C.
riddles.why: A calendar lists days, weeks and months of a year.

riddles.q: One a day of me is said to keep the doctor away. I am crunchy, red or green. What am I?
hints: I grow on a tree.
I am a fruit, round and juicy.
It has 5 letters and it starts with A.
riddles.why: An apple a day is said to keep the doctor away.

riddles.q: You peel me and I am yellow. Monkeys love me. What am I?
hints: I am a curved fruit.
I grow in bunches.
It has 6 letters and it starts with B.
riddles.why: A banana is peeled and yellow, and monkeys love it.

riddles.q: I am round and flat with cheese and tomato sauce, and I come in slices. What am I?
hints: I come in a box and a delivery guy brings me.
Pepperoni is a popular topping.
It has 5 letters and it starts with P.
riddles.why: Pizza is a round dish with sauce, cheese and slices.

riddles.q: I pop when you heat my kernels, and I smell good at the movies. What am I?
hints: I come in a bucket or a bag.
I am a snack with butter and salt.
It has 7 letters and it starts with P.
riddles.why: Popcorn kernels pop when heated.

riddles.q: I have candles on top and you sing to me on your birthday. What am I?
hints: I am sweet and baked in an oven.
You blow out the candles on me and make a wish.
It has 4 letters and it starts with C.
riddles.why: A birthday cake has candles on top.

riddles.q: I am a big orange fruit. On Halloween, people carve a face in me. What am I?
hints: I grow on a vine in the autumn.
I am a pie flavor in November.
It has 7 letters and it starts with P.
riddles.why: A pumpkin is a big orange fruit that is carved at Halloween.

riddles.q: I shine a little light in your mouth, I wear a mask, and I tell you to open wide. Who am I?
hints: I work in a clinic that kids visit twice a year.
I check your teeth and remind you to floss.
It has 7 letters and it starts with D.
riddles.why: A dentist looks after your teeth and asks you to open wide.

riddles.q: I sit on your nose and help you see clearly. What am I?
hints: I have two lenses and two arms.
Some people wear me to read.
It has 7 letters and it starts with G.
riddles.why: Glasses sit on your nose and help you see.

riddles.q: I sit on your head to keep off the sun or the cold. What am I?
hints: Wear me outdoors.
I might have a brim.
It has 3 letters and it starts with H.
riddles.why: A hat covers your head.

riddles.q: I am a mountain that erupts with hot lava and ash. What am I?
hints: I am found in Hawaii and Italy.
I rumble before I blow.
It has 7 letters and it starts with V.
riddles.why: A volcano erupts with lava and ash.

riddles.q: I am land surrounded by water on every side. What am I?
hints: I am found in the ocean.
Castaways get stranded on me.
It has 6 letters and it starts with I.
riddles.why: An island is land surrounded by water.

riddles.q: I make bubbles and wash away dirt in the bath. What am I?
hints: I live next to the sink.
I smell nice and I am slippery.
It has 4 letters and it starts with S.
riddles.why: Soap makes bubbles that wash dirt away.

riddles.q: I stand on a desk or table and give you light when you flip the switch. What am I?
hints: I have a shade and a bulb.
You turn me on at night to read.
It has 4 letters and it starts with L.
riddles.why: A lamp gives light when switched on.

riddles.q: I have two wheels and pedals. You ride me and ring my bell. What am I?
hints: I have handlebars.
Wear a helmet on me.
It has 7 letters and it starts with B.
riddles.why: A bicycle has two wheels and pedals.

riddles.q: I am very tall and rocky. Climbers want to reach my peak. What am I?
hints: I am bigger than a hill.
Snow covers my top.
It has 8 letters and it starts with M.
riddles.why: A mountain is a tall rocky peak.

riddles.q: I am orange and crunchy and I grow underground. Rabbits love to nibble me. What am I?
hints: I am a vegetable.
Bugs Bunny chomps on me.
It has 6 letters and it starts with C.
riddles.why: A carrot is an orange root vegetable that grows underground.

riddles.q: You must hit me to make me sing. I keep the beat. What am I?
hints: A band has me.
Use sticks to play me.
It has 4 letters and it starts with D.
riddles.why: A drum makes sound when it is hit.

riddles.q: I have a neck and strings, and you strum me. What am I?
hints: A rock star holds me.
I have six strings.
It has 6 letters and it starts with G.
riddles.why: A guitar has a neck and strings.

riddles.q: I have towers, a moat and a drawbridge. A king may live in me. What am I?
hints: Knights guard me.
I am a big stone fort.
It has 6 letters and it starts with C.
riddles.why: A castle has towers, a moat and a drawbridge.

riddles.q: I have a golden mane and I am called the king of the jungle. What am I?
hints: I roar.
I live in a pride.
It has 4 letters and it starts with L.
riddles.why: A lion is the king of beasts.

riddles.q: I am a big cat with orange fur and black stripes. What am I?
hints: I live in forests in Asia.
I am a hunter.
It has 5 letters and it starts with T.
riddles.why: A tiger is a big striped cat.

riddles.q: I have long ears and a fluffy tail. I hop and love carrots. What am I?
hints: I live in a burrow.
The Easter one brings eggs.
It has 6 letters and it starts with R.
riddles.why: A rabbit hops and has long ears.

riddles.q: I have a mane and a tail. You can ride me and I say neigh. What am I?
hints: I live in a stable.
I gallop.
It has 5 letters and it starts with H.
riddles.why: A horse has a mane and can be ridden.

riddles.q: I am big and yellow. I take children to school. What am I?
hints: I stop at corners.
The driver opens my door.
It has 3 letters and it starts with B.
riddles.why: A school bus carries children to school.

riddles.q: You sit on me, go back and forth, and kick your legs to go higher. What am I?
hints: I am at the playground.
I hang from chains.
It has 5 letters and it starts with S.
riddles.why: A swing moves back and forth.

riddles.q: I capture a moment, and I flash. Say cheese! What am I?
hints: I take pictures.
You hold me up to your eye.
It has 6 letters and it starts with C.
riddles.why: A camera takes photos.

riddles.q: What goes up every year but never comes back down?
hints: Everybody has one.
A new candle gets added to the cake each time it rises.
It has 3 letters and it starts with A.
riddles.why: Your age goes up on every birthday and never goes down.

riddles.q: What building has the most stories?
hints: You must be quiet inside.
You can borrow things here for free.
It has 7 letters and it starts with L.
riddles.why: A library has the most stories, because it is full of story books.

riddles.q: What is always in front of you but cannot be seen?
hints: It has not happened yet.
Next week belongs to it.
It has 6 letters and it starts with F.
riddles.why: The future is always ahead of you, but you cannot see it yet.

riddles.q: What has a bottom at the top?
hints: Your body has two of them.
They help you walk and run.
It has 4 letters and it starts with L.
riddles.why: Your bottom sits at the top of your legs.

riddles.q: What is black and white and read all over?
hints: A delivery person throws me on your doorstep.
I am full of headlines.
It has 9 letters and it starts with N.
riddles.why: A newspaper is black and white, and it is "read" all over, like red.

riddles.q: I am broken the moment you say my name. What am I?
hints: I fill a library.
Whisper and I am gone.
It has 7 letters and it starts with S.
riddles.why: Saying "silence" out loud breaks it.

riddles.q: The more you take away from me, the bigger I get. What am I?
hints: Dig with a shovel.
I appear in the ground, or in a sock.
It has 4 letters and it starts with H.
riddles.why: The more you dig out of a hole, the bigger the hole gets.

riddles.q: I have thirteen hearts but no other organs. What am I?
hints: Play a game with me.
I have four suits.
It is 3 words long and it starts with D.
riddles.why: A deck of cards has thirteen hearts, but no other organs.

riddles.q: What kind of room has no doors or windows?
hints: Think of the woods after rain.
I grow in the forest and can go in a soup.
It has 8 letters and it starts with M.
riddles.why: A mushroom is a room with no doors, and a pun on the word room.

riddles.q: I am as light as a feather, yet the strongest person cannot hold me for more than a few minutes. What am I?
hints: You do it all day without thinking.
Hold your nose and it stops.
It has 6 letters and it starts with B.
riddles.why: You can only hold your breath for a short time.

riddles.q: The more of me you take, the more you leave behind. What am I?
hints: Think of a walk on a muddy path or a sandy beach.
You make them when you walk, and you leave a trail of them.
It has 9 letters and it starts with F.
riddles.why: The more footsteps you take, the more of them you leave behind you.

riddles.q: I can travel all around the world while staying in a corner. What am I?
hints: I am small and I ride on mail.
You lick me and stick me on an envelope.
It has 5 letters and it starts with S.
riddles.why: A stamp stays in the corner of a letter while the letter travels the world.

riddles.q: What has branches but no fruit, no trunk and no leaves?
hints: Think about money.
You can open an account inside.
It has 4 letters and it starts with B.
riddles.why: A bank has branches in many towns, but it has no leaves, fruit or trunk.

riddles.q: I have cities with no houses, mountains with no trees, and water with no fish. What am I?
hints: I fold up and fit in a glove box.
Explorers use me to find their way.
It has 3 letters and it starts with M.
riddles.why: A map shows cities, mountains and water, but only as drawings.

riddles.q: Which months have twenty-eight days?
hints: Do not just think about February.
Count the days in each month, then find the minimum.
It is 3 words long and it starts with A.
riddles.why: Every month has at least twenty-eight days.

riddles.q: What is easy to get into but hard to get out of?
hints: You do not want to be in me at school.
If you break a window, you could find yourself in me.
It has 7 letters and it starts with T.
riddles.why: It is easy to get into trouble, and hard to get out of it.

riddles.q: What can you give to someone and still keep?
hints: It costs nothing, but it means a lot.
It is given with a handshake or a pinky swear.
It is 2 words long and it starts with Y.
riddles.why: You can give your word and still have it, since it is an honest pledge.

riddles.q: I have bark but I am not a dog. I have branches but no arms. What am I?
hints: I grow tall in the forest.
Birds build nests in me.
It has 4 letters and it starts with T.
riddles.why: A tree has bark and branches and is not an animal.

riddles.q: The more of me there is, the less you can see. What am I?
hints: I arrive when the sun goes down.
A flashlight chases me away.
It has 8 letters and it starts with D.
riddles.why: The more darkness there is, the less you can see.

riddles.q: I eat but never drink. Give me wood and I grow, give me water and I die. What am I?
hints: I am hot and bright.
I dance and crackle and need air to live.
It has 4 letters and it starts with F.
riddles.why: A fire grows when it eats fuel and dies when it is doused with water.

riddles.q: You can hear me but never see me. I can howl, and I push boats along. What am I?
hints: I move leaves and make kites dance.
I blow across the world.
It has 4 letters and it starts with W.
riddles.why: The wind is moving air. You hear it and feel it, but you cannot see it.

riddles.q: Everyone has me. I cannot be stopped or saved, but I can be spent and wasted. What am I?
hints: Clocks measure me.
I fly when you are having fun.
It has 4 letters and it starts with T.
riddles.why: Time passes for everyone and it can be spent, wasted and lost.

riddles.q: What belongs to you, but other people use it more than you do?
hints: You were given it at birth.
Friends call it out when they want your attention.
It has 4 letters and it starts with N.
riddles.why: Your name is yours, yet others say it far more often than you do.

riddles.q: If you tell me, I am no longer mine. What am I?
hints: Friends whisper me.
I stop being one if everyone knows.
It has 6 letters and it starts with S.
riddles.why: A secret is not a secret once you share it.

riddles.q: I am salty and deep. I have waves but no hands to wave. What am I?
hints: I cover most of the Earth.
Whales and sharks live in me.
It has 5 letters and it starts with O.
riddles.why: The ocean has waves, but it cannot wave back.

riddles.q: I come to you every night, whether you want me or not. I make your eyes close. What am I?
hints: Bedtime brings me.
After a long day, you will not say no.
It has 5 letters and it starts with S.
riddles.why: Sleep comes every night and closes your eyes.

riddles.q: I am catching. If you see someone else do me, you want to join. What am I?
hints: I spread around a room when people are tired.
Open wide and stretch.
It has 4 letters and it starts with Y.
riddles.why: A yawn is catching, since seeing one often makes you yawn too.

riddles.q: I roar in the sky after a flash and make dogs hide under the bed. What am I?
hints: I follow the lightning but I am slower.
I boom in a storm.
It has 7 letters and it starts with T.
riddles.why: Thunder is the loud boom that follows a lightning flash.

riddles.q: I flash in the stormy sky. It is said I never strike the same place twice. What am I?
hints: I appear before the rumble.
I am brighter than a camera flash.
It has 9 letters and it starts with L.
riddles.why: Lightning is a flash of electricity in a storm.

riddles.q: The biggest part of me hides under the sea. Ships should avoid me. What am I?
hints: I float in cold waters.
A famous ship hit one in 1912.
It has 7 letters and it starts with I.
riddles.why: Only the tip of an iceberg shows above the water.

riddles.q: I am a cloud that has come down to touch the ground. What am I?
hints: It is hard to see far when I am here.
I make mornings gray and damp.
It has 3 letters and it starts with F.
riddles.why: Fog is a cloud at ground level.

riddles.q: I am always coming, but I never arrive. What am I?
hints: Yesterday and today are my neighbors.
When it comes, it is called today.
It has 8 letters and it starts with T.
riddles.why: Tomorrow is always one day away. When it arrives, it is already today.

riddles.q: I am round and I spin on a stand. I show every country on one ball. What am I?
hints: Classrooms have me.
Spin me and point to a place.
It has 5 letters and it starts with G.
riddles.why: A globe is a round model of the Earth.

riddles.q: I am a tool with a needle that always points north. What am I?
hints: Hikers carry me.
I do not need batteries.
It has 7 letters and it starts with C.
riddles.why: A compass has a needle that points to the north.

riddles.q: I am heavy and I hold a ship in place. I sink to make it stay. What am I?
hints: Sailors drop me overboard.
I am attached to a chain.
It has 6 letters and it starts with A.
riddles.why: An anchor sinks and grips the seabed to keep a ship still.

riddles.q: I stand on a rocky shore. My beam warns ships of danger. What am I?
hints: I have a tall tower.
Sailors steer away from rocks thanks to me.
It has 10 letters and it starts with L.
riddles.why: A lighthouse shines a bright beam to guide ships.

riddles.q: Look through me to see far-off planets and stars. What am I?
hints: Astronomers use me.
I have a long tube and a lens.
It has 9 letters and it starts with T.
riddles.why: A telescope makes far away objects look nearer.

riddles.q: I make tiny things look big. Scientists use me to see germs. What am I?
hints: I have a lens and a slide.
You find me in a laboratory.
It has 10 letters and it starts with M.
riddles.why: A microscope magnifies tiny things.

riddles.q: I have degrees but I never went to school. What am I?
hints: A doctor places me under your tongue.
I tell you how hot or cold something is.
It has 11 letters and it starts with T.
riddles.why: A thermometer measures temperature in degrees.

riddles.q: You use me to measure and draw straight lines. I am also in charge of a kingdom. What am I?
hints: I am on your school desk.
I have inches or centimeters on my edge.
It has 5 letters and it starts with R.
riddles.why: A ruler measures lines, and a ruler also runs a country.

riddles.q: What starts with an E, ends with an E, and usually holds just one letter?
hints: You post me.
A stamp goes on my corner.
It has 8 letters and it starts with E.
riddles.why: An envelope starts and ends with E and holds a single letter.

riddles.q: I have teeth but I do not bite. I zip your jacket closed. What am I?
hints: I run up and down a jacket.
I have a little tab you pull.
It has 6 letters and it starts with Z.
riddles.why: A zipper has teeth that lock together.

riddles.q: I pull things to me without touching. I stick to the fridge. What am I?
hints: I attract iron.
I have a north and a south.
It has 6 letters and it starts with M.
riddles.why: A magnet attracts metal without touching it.

riddles.q: I have a positive and a negative end, and I power your toys. What am I?
hints: I am inside a remote control.
I run out of charge.
It has 7 letters and it starts with B.
riddles.why: A battery has positive and negative ends and stores power.

riddles.q: Two slices of bread and some filling. I was named after an earl. What am I?
hints: I am a popular lunch.
I may have ham, cheese or peanut butter.
It has 8 letters and it starts with S.
riddles.why: The sandwich was named after the Earl of Sandwich.

riddles.q: I make you cry when you cut me, but I am not sad. What am I?
hints: I am a layered vegetable.
Peel my skin and your eyes will water.
It has 5 letters and it starts with O.
riddles.why: An onion releases a gas that makes your eyes water.

riddles.q: I have eyes but I cannot see. I grow underground and I can be mashed or fried. What am I?
hints: I am a vegetable.
French fries are made from me.
It has 6 letters and it starts with P.
riddles.why: A potato has eyes, small buds on its skin, but it cannot see.

riddles.q: I have ears but I cannot hear. I grow in rows in a field. What am I?
hints: I am golden yellow.
You can eat me on the cob.
It has 4 letters and it starts with C.
riddles.why: An ear of corn has ears but no hearing.

riddles.q: I wear a crown, I am prickly, and I am sweet inside. What am I?
hints: I am a tropical fruit.
I have spikes and green leaves on top.
It has 9 letters and it starts with P.
riddles.why: A pineapple has a leafy crown and prickly skin.

riddles.q: I have a hairy brown shell and water inside. I fall from a palm. What am I?
hints: I grow on a beach.
You can drink from me with a straw.
It has 7 letters and it starts with C.
riddles.why: A coconut has a hairy shell and sweet water inside.

riddles.q: I am red and sweet. My seeds grow on the outside. What am I?
hints: I am a small fruit with a green top.
I go well with cream.
It has 10 letters and it starts with S.
riddles.why: A strawberry has its seeds on the outside.

riddles.q: I have needles but I never sew. I live in the desert and I am green. What am I?
hints: I store water in my body.
Do not hug me.
It has 6 letters and it starts with C.
riddles.why: A cactus has sharp spines, like needles, and stores water.

riddles.q: I follow the sun across the sky. I am tall and yellow, and I make seeds. What am I?
hints: I am a flower.
Birds love my seeds.
It has 9 letters and it starts with S.
riddles.why: A sunflower turns to face the sun.

riddles.q: I am a red flower with thorns on my stem. People give me on Valentine's Day. What am I?
hints: I smell sweet.
Poets say I am a symbol of love.
It has 4 letters and it starts with R.
riddles.why: A rose has thorns and is a symbol of love.

riddles.q: I am a tiny nut. From me, a mighty oak will grow. What am I?
hints: Squirrels bury me for winter.
I have a little cap.
It has 5 letters and it starts with A.
riddles.why: An acorn is the seed of an oak tree.

riddles.q: I have over two hundred bones, but I am not a person. I hang in a science class. What am I?
hints: I am inside every one of us.
Bones hold me up.
It has 8 letters and it starts with S.
riddles.why: A skeleton is the frame of bones inside a body.

riddles.q: I beat all day and all night, and I never rest. What am I?
hints: I am in your chest.
I pump blood around your body.
It has 5 letters and it starts with H.
riddles.why: Your heart beats day and night without rest.

riddles.q: I am yours alone. No one else in the world has the same one. I stay on glass you touch. What am I?
hints: Detectives look for me.
I am on the tips of your fingers.
It has 11 letters and it starts with F.
riddles.why: A fingerprint is a pattern on your fingertip, and no two are the same.

riddles.q: I have no bones, but I taste. I live in your mouth. What am I?
hints: I help you speak.
Lick an ice pop and I tell you it is cold.
It has 6 letters and it starts with T.
riddles.why: The tongue has no bones and lets you taste and speak.

riddles.q: I sit in the middle of your face. I smell, and I run when you have a cold. What am I?
hints: I have two nostrils.
Sneezes come from me.
It has 4 letters and it starts with N.
riddles.why: The nose smells and can run when you have a cold.

riddles.q: We are five letters, A, E, I, O and U, and nearly every word needs at least one of us. What are we?
hints: We are in the alphabet.
Every word needs one of us, almost.
It has 6 letters and it starts with V.
riddles.why: A, E, I, O and U are the vowels.

riddles.q: In me, "success" always comes before "work". What am I?
hints: I am a thick book.
I list words in alphabetical order.
It has 10 letters and it starts with D.
riddles.why: In a dictionary, "success" comes before "work" because S is before W.

riddles.q: I am a game with kings, queens, knights and pawns on a checkered board. What am I?
hints: Two players take turns to move me.
Check and mate are my words.
It has 5 letters and it starts with C.
riddles.why: Chess is a game with kings, queens and pawns.

riddles.q: I have six faces and a bunch of dots, but no eyes or mouth. What am I?
hints: You roll me in a board game.
I land on a number from one to six.
It has 4 letters and it starts with D.
riddles.why: Dice have six faces with dots.

riddles.q: I have hundreds of pieces and I come in a box. You fit me together to make a picture. What am I?
hints: I need a flat table.
The edges are the easiest to start with.
It is 2 words long and it starts with J.
riddles.why: A jigsaw puzzle has many pieces that fit together into a picture.

riddles.q: I have a tongue but I have no mouth. When I swing, I ring. What am I?
hints: I hang in a tower.
A cow may wear one.
It has 4 letters and it starts with B.
riddles.why: A bell has a tongue, called a clapper.

riddles.q: I have a bow but I shoot no arrows. I have strings and make music. What am I?
hints: I sit under your chin when you play.
An orchestra has many of me.
It has 6 letters and it starts with V.
riddles.why: A violin is played with a bow, but the bow does not shoot.

riddles.q: I make a high sound when you blow into me. A referee uses me. What am I?
hints: I hang on a string around the neck.
Blow and the game stops.
It has 7 letters and it starts with W.
riddles.why: A whistle makes a high sound when blown.

riddles.q: I hold time in sand. I run out, then you flip me. What am I?
hints: Two glass bulbs joined in the middle.
The sand falls from top to bottom.
It has 9 letters and it starts with H.
riddles.why: An hourglass measures time with falling sand.

riddles.q: I open in the sky and carry you gently down. What am I?
hints: Skydivers wear me.
I am like a big cloth umbrella.
It has 9 letters and it starts with P.
riddles.why: A parachute slows a fall.

riddles.q: I sail under the waves and hide from storms. What am I?
hints: I go deep in the ocean.
I have a periscope.
It has 9 letters and it starts with S.
riddles.why: A submarine sails underwater.

riddles.q: I have wings that do not flap and I carry hundreds of people above the clouds. What am I?
hints: I take off from a runway.
Passengers fasten their seat belts in me.
It has 8 letters and it starts with A.
riddles.why: An airplane has fixed wings and flies.

riddles.q: I have blades on top that spin. I can hover in place. What am I?
hints: I land on a rooftop.
I take off straight up.
It has 10 letters and it starts with H.
riddles.why: A helicopter's blades spin and let it hover.

riddles.q: Ten, nine, eight... I blast off with fire. I go to space. What am I?
hints: Astronauts ride me.
I leave a trail of smoke.
It has 6 letters and it starts with R.
riddles.why: A rocket blasts off into space after a countdown.

riddles.q: I go up and down all day, but I never leave my shaft. You press a button to ride me. What am I?
hints: Tall buildings have me.
I have doors that slide open.
It has 8 letters and it starts with E.
riddles.why: An elevator moves between floors.

riddles.q: I am round and rubber, filled with air. I help a car grip the road. What am I?
hints: I go on a wheel.
I can go flat.
It has 4 letters and it starts with T.
riddles.why: A tire is the air-filled rubber ring on a wheel.

riddles.q: I am a road through a mountain, dark inside. What am I?
hints: Trains and cars pass through me.
I have a light at the end.
It has 6 letters and it starts with T.
riddles.why: A tunnel is a passage dug through a mountain.

riddles.q: I am a house made of blocks of ice. What am I?
hints: Arctic people built me.
I keep warm inside even though I am frozen.
It has 5 letters and it starts with I.
riddles.why: An igloo is a dome house built of ice blocks.

riddles.q: I breathe fire and guard gold. I appear in fairy tales. What am I?
hints: I have wings and scales.
Knights try to slay me.
It has 6 letters and it starts with D.
riddles.why: A dragon is a fire-breathing creature from legends.

riddles.q: I look like a white horse, but I have a spiral horn on my head. What am I?
hints: I am magical.
I live in fairy tales.
It has 7 letters and it starts with U.
riddles.why: A unicorn is a horse-like creature with one horn.

riddles.q: I float, say "boo", and I'm see-through. I may haunt a house. What am I?
hints: I appear at Halloween.
Wearing a white sheet is a way to dress as me.
It has 5 letters and it starts with G.
riddles.why: A ghost is a spooky spirit in stories.

riddles.q: I sail the seas, I have a parrot, and I look for treasure. What am I?
hints: I say "Arr".
I fly a flag with a skull and bones.
It has 6 letters and it starts with P.
riddles.why: A pirate sails the sea hunting treasure.

riddles.q: A king or queen wears me on their head. What am I?
hints: I am gold with jewels.
Royals wear me at ceremonies.
It has 5 letters and it starts with C.
riddles.why: A crown is a royal hat.

riddles.q: Santa comes down me to bring gifts. Smoke goes up me. What am I?
hints: I am on a roof.
A fireplace is below me.
It has 7 letters and it starts with C.
riddles.why: A chimney carries smoke out of the house.

riddles.q: What is bought by the yard but worn by the foot?
hints: I cover a floor.
You walk on me inside.
It has 6 letters and it starts with C.
riddles.why: Carpet is sold by the yard and walked on by feet.

riddles.q: What has a heart that does not beat?
hints: I am a vegetable.
You eat my petals and then my middle.
It has 9 letters and it starts with A.
riddles.why: An artichoke has a heart, which is its tasty center.

riddles.q: I am black and sometimes green. A teacher writes on me with chalk. What am I?
hints: I hang in the front of the class.
Dusters wipe me clean.
It has 10 letters and it starts with B.
riddles.why: A blackboard is a surface for chalk.

riddles.q: What gets sharper the more you use it, and it is not a knife?
hints: I am inside your head.
The more you think, the better I get.
It has 5 letters and it starts with B.
riddles.why: Thinking and learning make your brain sharper.

riddles.q: What kind of coat is best put on wet?
hints: An artist uses a brush with me.
I come in a can.
It has 5 letters and it starts with P.
riddles.why: A coat of paint goes on wet and then dries.

riddles.q: I can be cracked, made, told and played. What am I?
hints: I make people laugh.
A comedian tells me.
It has 4 letters and it starts with J.
riddles.why: You can crack a joke, make a joke, tell a joke and play a joke.

riddles.q: I have a glowing tail but no body. I streak across the night sky every few decades. What am I?
hints: I am made of ice and dust.
Halley's is a famous one.
It has 5 letters and it starts with C.
riddles.why: A comet has a tail of gas and dust that glows near the sun.

riddles.q: I am a stretchy loop. I hold your hair or papers. What am I?
hints: I stretch and snap back.
Wrap me around a bundle.
It is 2 words long and it starts with R.
riddles.why: A rubber band is a stretchy loop.

riddles.q: You can hear me and make me, but you cannot touch or see me. What am I?
hints: Music is made of me.
Your ears collect me.
It has 5 letters and it starts with S.
riddles.why: Sound travels in waves that you hear.

riddles.q: What kind of tree can you carry in your hand?
hints: Think about your hand.
There is a tree with this name, too.
It has 4 letters and it starts with P.
riddles.why: Your palm is part of your hand, and a palm is also a tree.

riddles.q: I am full of letters but I cannot read. The postman fills me. What am I?
hints: I stand at the end of the driveway.
You put a flag up on me.
It has 7 letters and it starts with M.
riddles.why: A mailbox is full of letters.

riddles.q: I go into the water dark but come out red. What am I?
hints: I live in the sea.
I have claws and I turn red when cooked.
It has 7 letters and it starts with L.
riddles.why: A lobster turns red when it is cooked.

riddles.q: I am a round skin of soap and air. I shimmer with rainbow colors, and I vanish when touched. What am I?
hints: Kids blow me with a wand.
I pop.
It has 6 letters and it starts with B.
riddles.why: A bubble is a thin film of soap filled with air.

riddles.q: I am light, soft, and I come from a bird. People used to write with me. What am I?
hints: I help birds fly.
A pillow can be stuffed with me.
It has 7 letters and it starts with F.
riddles.why: A feather is light, and quills were once used as pens.

riddles.q: I am woven from twigs and straw high in a tree. Eggs wait inside me. What am I?
hints: Birds make me.
I am a cozy home for chicks.
It has 4 letters and it starts with N.
riddles.why: A nest is a bird's home for its eggs.

riddles.q: I am tiny but I can carry many times my own weight. I march in line. What am I?
hints: I live in a colony.
I am found at picnics.
It has 3 letters and it starts with A.
riddles.why: An ant is a tiny insect that can carry heavy loads.

riddles.q: I am a mammal of the sea, smart and playful. I click and whistle and leap through the waves. What am I?
hints: I swim in pods.
I breathe through a blowhole.
It has 7 letters and it starts with D.
riddles.why: A dolphin is a smart, playful sea mammal.

riddles.q: I am the largest animal that ever lived. I sing in the deep sea. What am I?
hints: I am a giant mammal.
I breathe air through a blowhole.
It has 5 letters and it starts with W.
riddles.why: A whale is the biggest animal on Earth.

riddles.q: My fin cuts the water and my jaws have rows of teeth. What am I?

riddles.q: I have eight arms and three hearts. I squirt ink to escape. What am I?

I am very clever.

riddles.q: I am a colorful bird who can mimic your words. What am I?

riddles.q: I am a huge bird with a white head. I soar high and I am a national symbol. What am I?

riddles.q: I have a bushy tail and I bury nuts for winter. What am I?

riddles.q: I stand in a field with a hat and straw for stuffing, and I scare the birds. What am I?

riddles.q: People gather around me and toast marshmallows. I crackle and glow at night. What am I?

You tell ghost stories by me.

riddles.q: I am soft and white. You roast me on a stick until I am gooey. What am I?

I go on a s'more.

riddles.q: You bounce on me and touch the sky. I have a springy mat. What am I?

riddles.q: I light the way on a camping trip and I hang from a hook. What am I?

I have a glass shield and a handle.

riddles.q: I am round and flat and golden. You flip me and pour syrup on me. What am I?

I come in a stack.

riddles.q: I come up each morning and chase away the stars. What am I?

I turn the sky orange and pink.

riddles.q: X marks the spot where you will find me. What am I?

I am found in a chest full of gold and jewels.

riddles.q: I am a dark hollow in a hillside. Bats live in me and echoes bounce around. What am I?

I am inside a mountain.

riddles.q: Water pours over a cliff in a mighty roar. What am I?

I make mist and rainbows.

riddles.q: Two friends sit at either end of me. When one goes up, the other goes down. What am I?

I balance on a middle point.

riddles.q: I move when someone pulls my strings. What am I?

A hand or strings move me.

riddles.q: I weigh things. Put a pile of fruit on me and I'll show how heavy it is. What am I?

I give you a number in pounds or kilos.
It has 5 letters and it starts with S.
riddles.why: A scale weighs things.

riddles.q: Forward I am heavy, but backward I am not. What am I?
hints: Read me the other way around.
I am a unit used to weigh very heavy things.

riddles.q: What comes once in a minute, twice in a moment, but never in a thousand years?

riddles.q: In the morning I walk on four legs, at noon on two, and in the evening on three. What am I?

Think about a whole lifetime as one day.

riddles.q: What can be seen in the middle of March and April that cannot be seen at the beginning or end of either month?

It is a single letter of the alphabet, and it is R.
riddles.why: The letter R is in the middle of "March" and "April", but not at their start or end.

riddles.q: What four-letter word reads the same forwards, backwards and upside down when written in capital letters?

The sun is high in the sky.

riddles.why: NOON written in capitals is the same when read backwards, and when turned upside down.

riddles.q: What English word has three pairs of double letters in a row?

Double O, double K, double E.

riddles.why: Bookkeeper has OO, KK and EE one after another.

riddles.q: The poor have it. The rich need it. If you eat it, you will die. What is it?

Say what is in an empty box.

riddles.q: I have no beginning, no end, and no corners. You can draw me with a compass. What am I?

I am round and flat.
It has 6 letters and it starts with C.
riddles.why: A circle has no corners, and its line has no beginning and no end.

riddles.q: What is the beginning of eternity, the end of time and space, the beginning of every end, and the end of every place?
hints: Look at the first or last letter of the key words.
Check how each word begins or ends.
It is a single letter of the alphabet, and it is E.
riddles.why: The letter E begins "eternity", ends "time" and "space", begins "end" and ends "place".

riddles.q: What comes out at night without being called, and is lost by day without being stolen?
hints: Look up when it is dark.
They twinkle.
It has 5 letters and it starts with S.
riddles.why: Stars come out at night and vanish in the daylight.

riddles.q: Take away the whole and some is left. What word am I?
hints: I'm a word that means good for you.
Take a part off the beginning of me.
It has 9 letters and it starts with W.
riddles.why: Remove "whole" from "wholesome" and "some" is left.

riddles.q: What cheese is made backwards?
hints: Spell it in reverse.
It is a Dutch cheese.
It has 4 letters and it starts with E.
riddles.why: "Edam" spelled backwards is "made".

riddles.q: Which weighs more, a pound of feathers or a pound of bricks?
hints: Read the numbers carefully.
A pound is a pound.
It has 7 letters and it starts with N.
riddles.why: A pound of feathers and a pound of bricks both weigh one pound.

riddles.q: What letter comes next? O, T, T, F, F, S, S, E, ...
hints: Think of counting.
These letters begin number words in order.
It is a single letter of the alphabet, and it is N.
riddles.why: The letters start the numbers one, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, so nine is next.

riddles.q: What letter comes next? J, F, M, A, M, J, J, A, S, O, N, ...
hints: Think of a calendar.
These letters begin the months in order.
It is a single letter of the alphabet, and it is D.
riddles.why: They begin January through November, so the next month, December, starts with D.

riddles.q: What city is made from 3/7 of a chicken, 2/3 of a cat and 2/4 of a goat?
hints: Count the letters of each animal.
Take the first letters from each animal and join them.
It has 7 letters and it starts with C.
riddles.why: "Chi" from chicken, "ca" from cat and "go" from goat make Chicago.

riddles.q: I am an odd number. Take away one letter and I become even. What number am I?
hints: I am a lucky number.
Take away my first letter.
It has 5 letters and it starts with S.
riddles.why: Remove the S from "seven" and you have "even".

riddles.q: What starts with P, ends with E and has thousands of letters?
hints: I am a building.
A mail carrier works here.
It is 2 words long and it starts with P.
riddles.why: The post office starts with P, ends with E and handles thousands of letters.

riddles.q: Which word is said to be the longest, since a whole mile lies between its first and last letters?
hints: Put a measure of distance between two copies of one letter.
It has something to do with a happy face.
It has 6 letters and it starts with S.
riddles.why: Smiles is the longest word, since there is a mile between its first and last letters.

riddles.q: How many times does the digit 9 appear when you write every whole number from 1 to 100?
hints: Do not forget the numbers in the nineties.
Units place gives ten and tens place gives ten.
It is a number with 2 digits and it starts with 2.
riddles.why: Nine appears ten times as a last digit and ten times in the nineties, so 20.

riddles.q: A man pushes his car along the road and stops at a hotel. He instantly knows he is bankrupt. What is he doing?
hints: He is not really driving.
It is a game on a table.
It has 8 letters and it starts with M.
riddles.why: He is playing a board game where you can go bankrupt when you land on a hotel.

riddles.q: A man points at a portrait and says: "Brothers and sisters I have none, but that man's father is my father's only boy." Who is in the portrait?
hints: Work out who the speaker's father's only boy is.
The speaker has no brother, so the boy is the speaker.
It is 2 words long and it starts with H.
riddles.why: The only boy of his father is himself, so the man in the portrait is his son.

riddles.q: What do you call a word that reads the same forwards and backwards, like "level" or "racecar"?
hints: It is a type of wordplay.
The word has the same letters from both ends.
It has 10 letters and it starts with P.
riddles.why: A palindrome is a word that reads the same in both directions.

riddles.q: I have twenty-six letters inside me but only three syllables. What am I?
hints: I'm what you learn first in school.
A to Z.
It has 8 letters and it starts with A.
riddles.why: The alphabet has twenty-six letters and three syllables.

riddles.q: What is always ahead of you, yet you can never reach it?
hints: Look out to sea.
It is where the sky seems to meet the ground.
It has 7 letters and it starts with H.
riddles.why: The horizon moves away as you walk toward it.

riddles.q: I can be driven, filed, painted, trimmed or bitten. What am I?
hints: I'm at your hands and in a toolbox.
A hammer uses me.
It has 4 letters and it starts with N.
riddles.why: A nail can be hammered, filed, painted or bitten.

riddles.q: I go into hot water, and the longer I stay, the stronger the water gets. What am I?
hints: I belong in a cup.
Steep me for a few minutes.
It has 6 letters and it starts with T.
riddles.why: A teabag colors and flavors the water.

riddles.q: You can hold me without touching me, and the longer you hold me, the heavier I feel. What am I?
hints: I am a feeling.
You have it when you will not forgive someone.
It has 6 letters and it starts with G.
riddles.why: A grudge is a feeling that you carry for a long time.

riddles.q: I am your twin in a still pond. Toss in a stone and I ripple away. What am I?
hints: I live on the surface of water.
I show what is in front of me.
It has 10 letters and it starts with R.
riddles.why: A reflection in a pond breaks apart when the water ripples.

riddles.q: I am the reason you drop things and never float away. I cannot be seen. What am I?
hints: Newton wondered about me while watching an apple.
I pull everything toward the center of the Earth.
It has 7 letters and it starts with G.
riddles.why: Gravity pulls objects toward the Earth.

riddles.q: I am invisible and you breathe me every minute. Plants make me. What am I?
hints: I'm in the air.
Humans need me to live.
It has 6 letters and it starts with O.
riddles.why: Oxygen is a gas in the air, produced by plants, that animals breathe.

riddles.q: I run through wires and light up your house. I can shock you, so do not touch. What am I?
hints: I travel at the speed of light in a cable.
Plug me in.
It has 11 letters and it starts with E.
riddles.why: Electricity flows through wires to power things.

riddles.q: I am small, but I keep you going through the darkest night. They say I spring eternal. What am I?

I'm what you have when you wish for the best.
It has 4 letters and it starts with H.
riddles.why: Hope is the feeling that good things can happen.

riddles.q: I am not the absence of fear, but acting even though you are afraid. What am I?

It has 7 letters and it starts with C.
riddles.why: Courage is doing the right thing despite fear.

riddles.q: The more I am tested, the more I grow. I am a virtue, and I am the key to waiting. What am I?

I'm what you need while waiting.
It has 8 letters and it starts with P.
riddles.why: Patience grows when you practice waiting calmly.

riddles.q: I am contagious and I sound like "ha ha". They call me the best medicine. What am I?

Giggles are a small form of me.
It has 8 letters and it starts with L.
riddles.why: Laughter is a happy sound that spreads.

riddles.q: I am a statement that seems to contradict itself, and yet may be true. What am I?

It has 7 letters and it starts with P.
riddles.why: A paradox sounds impossible but can still be true.

riddles.q: I am a dark outline with no details inside, against a bright background. What am I?

It has 10 letters and it starts with S.
riddles.why: A silhouette is the dark shape of an object against the light.

riddles.q: When the moon hides the sun, day turns to dusk for a few minutes. What am I called?

You need special glasses to look at me.
It has 7 letters and it starts with E.
riddles.why: An eclipse is when one heavenly body blocks light from another.

riddles.q: I come in and go out twice a day, pulled by the moon. What am I?

It has 4 letters and it starts with T.
riddles.why: The tide is the rise and fall of the sea.

riddles.q: I am an imaginary line around the middle of the Earth. What am I?

It has 7 letters and it starts with E.
riddles.why: The equator splits the Earth into two hemispheres.

riddles.why: An avalanche is snow sliding down a mountain.

Dorothy was carried off by one.
It has 7 letters and it starts with T.
riddles.why: A tornado is a rotating funnel of air.

riddles.q: In the desert, I am a green patch with water and palm trees. What am I?

It is the place where camels drink.
It has 5 letters and it starts with O.
riddles.why: An oasis is a fertile spot with water in a desert.

riddles.q: I look like a lake in the hot desert, but vanish when you get close. What am I?

It has 6 letters and it starts with M.
riddles.why: A mirage is an illusion caused by hot air bending light.

riddles.q: I tell time using only a shadow and a flat plate. What am I?

I sit in a garden.

riddles.why: A sundial shows the time by the position of a shadow.

riddles.q: I have many twisting paths but only one way out. What am I?

It has 4 letters and it starts with M.
riddles.why: A maze has many paths and one way out.

riddles.q: I am a stone imprint of a creature that lived millions of years ago. What am I?

Dinosaur bones turn into me.
It has 6 letters and it starts with F.
riddles.why: A fossil is the preserved remains of an ancient animal or plant.

riddles.q: I am a giant triangle-sided tomb in the Egyptian desert. What am I?

Pharaohs were buried in me.
It has 7 letters and it starts with P.
riddles.why: A pyramid is a giant stone structure with triangular sides.

riddles.q: I change color to hide and I roll my eyes in two directions at once. What am I?

I shoot out a sticky tongue.
It has 9 letters and it starts with C.
riddles.why: A chameleon changes color and moves its eyes independently.

riddles.q: I'm a furry mammal with a bill like a duck, I lay eggs, and I live in Australia. What am I?
hints: I'm a very odd animal.
I have webbed feet and a flat tail.
It has 8 letters and it starts with P.
riddles.why: A platypus is a furry, egg-laying mammal with a duck's bill.

riddles.q: I am covered in sharp quills but I am not a hedgehog. What am I?
hints: I'm a rodent.
Do not touch me.
It has 9 letters and it starts with P.
riddles.why: A porcupine is covered in sharp quills.

riddles.q: I light up the summer night, but I am no fire and no fly. What am I?
hints: I am an insect.
My tail glows.
It has 7 letters and it starts with F.
riddles.why: A firefly is a beetle that glows at night.

riddles.q: I am a tiny bird who beats my wings so fast they hum. I sip nectar while hovering. What am I?
hints: I'm smaller than your hand.
I can fly backward.
It has 11 letters and it starts with H.
riddles.why: A hummingbird beats its wings dozens of times per second and hovers.

riddles.q: I knock on tree trunks all day, searching for bugs. What am I?
hints: I'm a bird.
Tap, tap, tap.
It has 10 letters and it starts with W.
riddles.why: A woodpecker taps trees with its beak.

riddles.q: I'm a small fish who swims upright, and the dad carries the babies. What am I?
hints: I live in the ocean.
I have a curled tail.
It has 8 letters and it starts with S.
riddles.why: A seahorse swims upright and the male carries the eggs.

riddles.q: I have no brain, no bones, and I float and sting. What am I?
hints: I live in the sea.
I have tentacles.
It has 9 letters and it starts with J.
riddles.why: A jellyfish has no brain or bones and stings with tentacles.

riddles.q: I stay green all winter, I have thousands of needles, and I smell like a forest. What am I?
hints: I am an evergreen.
I'm a popular Christmas tree.
It has 4 letters and it starts with P.
riddles.why: A pine tree keeps its needles all year.

riddles.q: I am made mostly of holes, yet I can catch a fish. What am I?
hints: A fisherman holds me.
I am woven from string.
It has 3 letters and it starts with N.
riddles.why: A net is mostly holes, yet it catches fish.

riddles.q: Thirty white horses on a red hill. First they champ, then they stamp, then they stand still. What are they?
hints: They live in your mouth.
You brush them morning and night.
It has 5 letters and it starts with T.
riddles.why: Teeth are the thirty white horses on the red hill of your gums.

riddles.q: Black we are, but much admired. Men seek us until they are tired. We tire the horse but comfort man. What are we?
hints: We are dug from the ground.
We are burned for heat.
It has 4 letters and it starts with C.
riddles.why: Coal is black, men dig for it, and it keeps people warm.

riddles.q: I live in winter, I die in summer, and I grow with my root upward. What am I?
hints: I hang from the roof.
I am pointed and melt in the sun.
It has 6 letters and it starts with I.
riddles.why: An icicle grows downward from its root and melts in summer.

riddles.q: A white bird, featherless, flew from heaven and perched on the castle wall. Lord Landless took it up handless and rode away horseless. What was the bird?
hints: It comes down in winter.
The sun takes it away.
It has 4 letters and it starts with S.
riddles.why: Snow falls like a bird and is melted away by the sun.

riddles.q: What letter is at the center of gravity?
hints: Spell the word.
Find the middle of the word "gravity".
It is a single letter of the alphabet, and it is V.
riddles.why: The middle letter of "gravity" is V.

riddles.q: What can be found at the end of a rainbow?
hints: It is not a pot of gold.
Look at how the word is spelled.
It is a single letter of the alphabet, and it is W.
riddles.why: "Rainbow" ends with the letter W.

riddles.q: Take away four of my five letters and I sound exactly the same. What word am I?
hints: You stand in me for a ride.
Four of my five letters are vowels.
It has 5 letters and it starts with Q.
riddles.why: After "queue" loses UEUE, the letter Q still sounds the same.

riddles.q: There is a mighty river with four eyes that cannot see. What is its name?
hints: It is a name, not an animal.
Look at how many times one letter repeats in its spelling.
It has 11 letters and it starts with M.
riddles.why: "Mississippi" has four letter I's, which look like eyes.

riddles.q: How many letters are in the phrase "the alphabet"?
hints: Count only letters.
Three plus eight.
It has 6 letters and it starts with E.
riddles.why: "The" has three and "alphabet" has eight, so 11.

riddles.q: What comes next in the sequence? 1, 11, 21, 1211, 111221, ...
alt: three one two two one one
hints: Read each number aloud, in groups of the same digit.
One 1, then two 1s, then one 2 and one 1...
It is a number with 6 digits and it starts with 3.
riddles.why: Each term describes the one before it: 111221 is three 1s, two 2s, one 1, written 312211.

riddles.q: What number comes next? 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, ...
hints: Add the two before.
Each number is the sum of the previous two.
It is a number with 2 digits and it starts with 1.
riddles.why: This is the Fibonacci sequence, so 5 plus 8 is 13.

riddles.q: What number comes next? 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, ...
hints: They are special numbers.
They are only divisible by themselves and one.
It is a number with 2 digits and it starts with 1.
riddles.why: They are prime numbers, so the next prime after 13 is 17.

riddles.q: I am a three-digit number. My tens digit is five more than my ones digit, and my hundreds digit is eight less than my tens digit. What number am I?
hints: Try the ones digit first.
Tens digit of 9 gives a hundreds digit of 1.
It is a number with 3 digits and it starts with 1.
riddles.why: If the ones digit is 4, the tens digit is 9 and the hundreds digit is 1.

riddles.q: I hold your place in a story without holding your hand. What am I?
hints: I'm used by readers.
I sit between two pages.
It has 8 letters and it starts with B.
riddles.why: A bookmark marks your place in a book.

riddles.q: I am a secret word that opens digital doors. You should never share me. What am I?
hints: Your phone asks for me.
Make me long and strong.
It has 8 letters and it starts with P.
riddles.why: A password protects your accounts.

riddles.q: I am nothing, yet when I stand behind a one I make ten. What am I?
hints: I am a number.
I mean none.
It has 4 letters and it starts with Z.
riddles.why: Zero stands for nothing, but 1 followed by 0 is 10.

riddles.q: I have no end, I lie on my side, and I look like an eight. What am I?
hints: A symbol in mathematics.
I mean forever.
It has 8 letters and it starts with I.
riddles.why: Infinity has no end, and its symbol looks like a sideways eight.

riddles.q: I make "time" and "lime" belong together. What am I?
hints: Poets use me.
Words that end with the same sound.
It has 5 letters and it starts with R.
riddles.why: Time and lime rhyme because they end in the same sound.

riddles.q: I am the day you cannot visit, even though you lived through me. What am I?
hints: I'm a day.
Today came right after me.
It has 9 letters and it starts with Y.
riddles.why: Yesterday is the day before today and you cannot return to it.

riddles.q: I settle on shelves and under beds. I am made of tiny bits, and I make you sneeze. What am I?
hints: I'm gray and fluffy.
A feather broom chases me away.
It has 4 letters and it starts with D.
riddles.why: Dust is fine particles that settle on surfaces.
